scope: Standing 1904 gravity spillway dam, its masonry wings, downstream apron and gauge access at Tai Tam Byewash Reservoir.
geometryBasis: Original mapped dam way 270274610 and the impounded edge of Byewash Reservoir way 22505710. The official 50 m observed length informs the wing extent.
sectionBasis: Continuous masonry-faced overflow sill at 151.4 m HKPD, a rounded crest, battered gravity spillway face, coursed-rubble wings and west gauge stair.
limitations: The source map anchors the central spillway and downstream apron. The official overall length is about 50 m. Wing wall junctions, individual masonry courses, exact crest shape and mounting details are estimates.
The published full water level establishes the overflow threshold. The model follows the original Lands Department terrain; the downstream toe and hidden foundation are approximate.
The subsidiary dam valve house and the upstream aqueduct are distinct geographic structures. The surrounding reservoir surface belongs to the scene.
